data.notes: Tap-to-try examples for the phone app and the jury demo. Written by the team to mirror publicly reported scam patterns; they are not real messages. Demo UPI codes use the handle @sahayakdemo, which no UPI app can resolve, so a printed or on-screen demo code can never pay a real account.
